from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

            "PDEs link the string's shape to its future motion.",

        ]
        
        self.setup_layout(title, lecture_lines)

        arrow_color = "#FF0000"

        amp_tracker = ValueTracker(0) # 0 for flat, 1 for full sine

        # Create the string as a VMobject
        # We define it over the area C1 to D6
        left_bound = self.grid["C1"][0]
        right_bound = self.grid["C6"][0]
        center_y = self.grid["C3"][1]
        width = right_bound - left_bound
        num_points = 50
        
        string = VMobject(color=string_color)
        
        def update_string(mob):
            t = time_tracker.get_value()
            a = amp_tracker.get_value()
            o = osc_tracker.get_value()
            
            # If o=0, cos(0)=1, so static shape. If o=1, it oscillates.
            # Standing wave: u(x,t) = A * sin(kx) * cos(wt)
            # k = pi / width (fundamental mode)
            # w = oscillation frequency
            points = []
            for i in range(num_points + 1):
                dx = (i / num_points) * width
                x = left_bound + dx
                # Fundamental mode: sin(pi * dx / width)
                u = a * 0.8 * np.sin(np.pi * dx / width) * np.cos(3 * t * o)
                points.append([x, center_y + u, 0])
            mob.set_points_as_corners(points)

        string.add_updater(update_string)
        update_string(string) # Initial state

        # Create Arrows (Force)
        # We'll place arrows at key points: 1/4, 1/2, 3/4 of the width
        arrows = VGroup()
        for i in [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]:
            arrow = Arrow(
                start=UP, end=DOWN, 
                color=arrow_color, 
                buff=0, 
                stroke_width=4, 
                max_tip_length_to_length_ratio=0.3
            )
            arrow.pos_ratio = i
            arrows.add(arrow)

        def update_arrows(mob_group):
            a = amp_tracker.get_value()
            o = osc_tracker.get_value()
            t = time_tracker.get_value()
            
            # Arrows only visible when there is displacement
            current_amp = a * np.cos(3 * t * o)
            
            for arrow in mob_group:
                dx = arrow.pos_ratio * width
                x = left_bound + dx
                y_pos = center_y + current_amp * 0.8 * np.sin(np.pi * arrow.pos_ratio)
                
                # Force is proportional to -u (towards center)
                if abs(current_amp) < 0.01:
                    arrow.set_opacity(0)
                else:
                    arrow.set_opacity(1)
                    # Position arrow tip at the string, pointing to center_y
                    start_y = y_pos
                    end_y = center_y
                    
                    # Update arrow geometry
                    arrow.put_start_and_end_on(
                        [x, start_y, 0],
                        [x, end_y, 0]
                    )

        arrows.add_updater(update_arrows)

        # Glow Effect
        glow_string = string.copy().set_color(glow_color).set_stroke(width=8, opacity=0.4)
        glow_string.add_updater(lambda m: m.set_points(string.get_points()))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # "A plucked guitar string demonstrates the wave equation."
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(string_color))
        self.play(Create(string), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1)

        self.wait(1)

        # "This force creates acceleration, changing its velocity over time."
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(arrow_color))
        self.play(Create(arrows))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # "PDEs link the string's shape to its future motion."
        self.play(self.lecture[3].animate.set_color(WHITE))
        self.play(osc_tracker.animate.set_value(1))
        # Add the time updater
        self.add(time_tracker.add_updater(lambda dt, dt_val: dt.set_value(dt.get_value() + dt_val)))
        self.wait(3)

        # "Watch how the wave travels through the material."
        self.play(self.lecture[4].animate.set_color(glow_color))
        self.add(glow_string)
        # Pulsing effect for glow
        self.play(
            glow_string.animate(rate_func=there_and_back).set_stroke(width=15, opacity=0.8),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(3)

        # Cleanup
        time_tracker.remove_updater(time_tracker.updaters[0])
        self.wait(1)
